content: भेदन {%a.%} [भिद्-णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा] .²1 Breaking, dividing <ab>&c.</ab>; नरनागाश्ववृन्दानां भेदनं क्षिप्रकारिणम् <ls>Mb. 6. 108. 8</ls>. .²2 Loosening (as the feces), purgative. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Splitting, breaking, rending. .²2 Dividing, separating. .²3 Distinguishing. .²4 Sowing dissensions, creating discord. .²5 Dissolving, loosening. .²6 Disclosing, betraying. .²7 Disunion, discord. .²8 Asa Foetida. .²9 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) Passing through a constellation. .²10 Piercing the nostril (of an animal for bridling; नासाच्छेदन); गोषु ब्राह्मणसंस्थासु छुरिकायाश्च भेदने <ls>Ms. 8. 325</ls>. .²11 A purgative. .{@-नः@} A hog.
